UPDATE 0.5 – DUNGEONS

Meditate, break through the realms and fly your sword to the sky islands! ⚔️☁️

Begin as a mortal at the foot of the mountain. Gather Qi with one button, even while AFK, and climb all the way to the new 9th realm – Immortal.

⚡ Breakthroughs with visible odds. Failing never resets your progress
🎲 Roll rare Spiritual Roots
🌩️ Survive the Heavenly Tribulation
♻️ Be reborn to make your Qi flow faster forever

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite so you don't miss new realms!
